items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: And I can't think of the name of the drum, but it might have been Big Gordon. Alex Big Gordon. Yeah, it might have been him on the drum, but that was a very fine band too at that time, down on the roof garden.

ctx.x: Yeah, Fields, yeah. That's right. And I can't think of the name of the drum, but it might have been Big Gordon. Alex Big Gordon. Yeah, it might have been him on the drum, but that was a very fine band too at that time, down on the roof garden. And he used to give Caffrey a lot of solos, because he could pick a band and make it sound like a horn blowing.
You've always been taking solos, I guess.
